## Installation

You can install the release version of `markov` from CRAN by running the following line of code:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
 install.packages("markov")
```

You can install the development version of `markov` from github by running the following line of code:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
 devtools::install_github("thechibo/markov")
```

More details can be found in the [markov Github repository](https://github.com/thechibo/markov "markov Github repository").

## Documentation

Detailed documentation, along with reproducible examples, can be found in the package vignette `vignette(topic = "markov", package = "markov")`.
